problem_type: A change made on the paid card was merged into the shot's candidate without the rule every other patch path uses, so switching the mode on the card left the task kind behind
symptom: pb02 (2026-10-02): with a canvas reference the card switched itself to Image-to-image and pressed Generate this one; Nomi said it did not start and did not charge. The main process logged 'catalog generation parameter is unsupported: image_urls': the dispatch picked the provider's text-to-image mapping, which takes no reference images. The same happens when the person switches Text-to-image to Image-to-image, or Text-to-video to Image-to-video, on the card by hand.
direct_cause: electron/capabilityCore/appIntegrationSpendConfirm.ts revise passed the card's patch straight to generation.revise (productionGenerationPlanEdits.applyGenerationCandidatePatch), so a patch with only modeId changed the archetype mode id and kept the old task kind (mode); electron/capabilityCore/generationPlanPatch.ts resolvePlanPatch, which the Agent's draft patch goes through, did not derive the task kind from a changed modeId either.
class_root: Two write paths patch the same candidate (the Agent's draft patch and the card's revise) and only one went through the shared merge rule; and the merge rule followed the task kind for a model change but not for a mode change, although modeId and mode are two spellings of one fact.
affected_population: Every paid card where the mode changes: the card aligning itself to canvas references, or the person switching the mode bar
Card model changes across catalogs with different mode spellings (now normalized by the same rule as the Agent's patch)
entry_points: The Agent's draft patch: draft_shots / generation patch -> mcpGenerationTools -> resolvePlanPatch -> operations.patch -> generation.patch (applyGenerationCandidatePatch)

The paid card no longer patches the candidate (2026-10-24): its revise IPC, appIntegrationSpendConfirm.revise / normalizePatch and the generation.revise command are deleted; parameters change only on the canvas node
internal_only_reason: How a patch merges into a shot's candidate and which task kind an archetype mode means are Nomi's own catalog and archetype rules.

invariant_owner_layer.why: resolvePlanPatch is the one merge rule for candidate patches: the task kind follows a model change or a mode change (via modeTransportFor, the same function the canvas and the video normalizer use), and the model and mode pair is admitted against the catalog. Since 2026-10-24 the Agent's draft patch is its only caller: the card edits nothing.

invariants: A candidate's task kind and its archetype mode id never disagree after a patch: changing modeId alone moves the task kind to that mode's transport kind in the catalog's spelling.
Every patch to a shot's candidate goes through the same merge rule before it is written; the Agent's draft patch is the only patch path (the paid card shows the node and edits nothing).

door_reduction.why_not: The card's revise doors (normalizePatch, its injection in appIntegration and in the test world) are deleted with the old card; what remains is the one rule, its one caller and the one writer of the merged result (generation.patch -> applyGenerationCandidatePatch).

generality_proof: The task kind is derived from the model's archetype mode through modeTransportFor and written in the catalog's own spelling (declaredModeForModel), so it covers image and video archetypes, vendor-specific transports and any catalog spelling without a model-specific branch; video candidates already followed modeId inside normalizeVideoCandidate, images had no equivalent.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Merges a patch into a shot's candidate: the task kind follows a model or mode change, leftover parameters are cleared, named parameters and the model/mode pair are admitted.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses resolvePlanPatch; the task kind follows a modeId-only patch (generationPlanPatch.test.ts).
Video candidates derive the transport kind from modeId at every compile point; the merge rule agrees with it before the compile.
Writes an Agent revision onto the landed node key by key from the already merged candidate (only the keys the Agent changed); it never merges a patch into the candidate (landedShotIntent.test.ts).

recurrence.reason: The paid card's A2 change (2026-10-01) routed every shot-building path through admitShotIdentity but missed the card's own revise; the same shape (one entry skipping the shared rule) is what that change set out to remove. Since 2026-10-24 the card has no write path at all.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs --write=resolvePlanPatch,applyGenerationCandidatePatch --read=modeForArchetypeMode,declaredModeForModel (2026-10-24: 4 doors; normalizePatch is gone)
rg "operations.revise\(|operations.patch\(" electron -> only the MCP patch; operations.revise no longer exists

prevention.invariant: Every candidate patch goes through resolvePlanPatch, which keeps the task kind and the archetype mode id in agreement; the paid card has no patch path.
prevention.failure_mode: A patch whose model or mode cannot be admitted is refused when it is made, not later at dispatch.
prevention.strategy: Derive the task kind from a changed modeId with modeTransportFor in the merge rule; delete the card's revise path (2026-10-24) so the rule has one caller.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24, deleted in place: the card's revise action (appIntegrationSpendConfirm.revise / normalizePatch), the generation.revise command and its plan edit. The card no longer writes the candidate, so the merge rule has one caller.

migration: No stored data changes. Drafts already saved with a mismatched mode and modeId are corrected by the next patch; video drafts were already normalized at compile. 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; the card revise path (appIntegrationSpendConfirm.revise / normalizePatch, generation.revise) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record).
residual_risks: Parameter edits on the canvas node are node meta, not candidate patches, so they do not go through resolvePlanPatch; what is sent is what the node holds (electron/parity/draftNodeSendParity.test.ts pins draft -> node -> request).
